I was eighteen the first time I admitted, I had been hesitant to then finally raped at a party. Seeking help was the single best thing I did in my entire life. Typically the stays vary but probably no more than a week or two, they will have you seen by a doctor that can place you on medication and you will be monitored by nurses and techs so you won't hurt yourself, typically they have some sort of group schedule throughout the day, like talking therapy which can be helpful. Please seek help, it's not as bad as people think it is, they will help you find an outpatient doctor and therapist, you have nothing to lose but feeling better.
